_comment: 🔮️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform: `ruststep` 0.4 registered as the real ISO 10303-21 reader for stdio.ifc 4/✳️any's exhaustive IfcMutation vocabulary, the mutation catalog it is measured against, and the tolerant structural comparison profile a re-serialized IFC4 exchange structure needs against an independently parsed one.

oracles.rationale: IFC4 rides the same ISO 10303-21 (STEP physical file / Part-21) exchange-structure grammar as AP214 -- ruststep's `ast::Exchange`/`ast::DataSection`/`ast::Record`/`ast::Parameter`/`ast::EntityInstance` all implement `FromStr` over the real Part-21 clear-text grammar at the SYNTAX level only; ruststep compiles no IFC4 EXPRESS schema module at all, so this is a genuinely schema-agnostic reader, confirmed against this subset's own real fixture (a real 2.5 MB IfcOpenShell 0.8.4 export of the Nakagin Capsule Tower, 24792 entities, parsed with zero errors -- see `../🧪️oracle/🦀️component.rs`'s own `parses_the_real_fixture_and_projects_it` test). It has NO writer at all: `ast::ser::to_record` only builds a `Record` from an already-typed Rust struct, and grepping the crate for `Display`/`fmt::Formatter` impls on `Exchange`/`DataSection`/`Record`/`Parameter` finds none -- there is no serialize path back to Part-21 text anywhere in the crate (the same finding this wave's STEP AP214 case already made independently). Per the fleet brief's §6, this rules out `@mode-differential`: ruststep cannot be a second PRODUCER of mutated bytes to diff against. It is registered here strictly as the INDEPENDENT READER role -- every real mutation this subset's own oracle dispatcher (`../🧪️oracle/🦀️component.rs`) performs (via ruststep's real parse plus this module's own from-scratch Part-21 writer, since none exists to reuse) is read back through a FRESH, independent `ruststep::ast::Exchange::from_str` call before being projected onto `semantic-ifc-v1`, and the identity round trip is checked the same way. This is real third-party evidence about the STRUCTURE of the result (entity graph shape, header schema, argument values as ruststep's own parser sees them), even though it cannot discharge a byte-level differential claim.

comparisonProfiles.description: IFC4 (ISO 10303-21 exchange structures carrying IFC4's own EXPRESS schema) compared by declared FILE_SCHEMA and the full id-keyed entity graph (name plus positional argument values, reals tolerant). Header timestamp, preprocessor/originating-system strings, comment placement and line-wrapping are writer freedom -- the same normative surface IfcDiff/IfcMutation themselves operate over.
